```{r}
seurat_neurospheres <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_neurospheres.rds"))
seurat_bioinert <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_bioinert.rds"))
seurat_biofunctional <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_biofunctional.rds"))
```

```{r}
# 1) Load & tag
NS         <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_neurospheres.rds"))
BP_Control <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_bioinert.rds"))
BP_Cues    <- readRDS(here("data/seurat_biofunctional.rds"))

NS$condition         <- "NS"
BP_Control$condition <- "BP_Control"
BP_Cues$condition    <- "BP_Cues"

# 2) Merge to one object
obj <- merge(NS, y = list(BP_Control, BP_Cues))
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$condition)

# 2) Unintegrated workflow (as in the vignette)
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj)
obj <- RunPCA(obj)
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

# 3) Integrate layers (adds an integrated reduction)
obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object         = obj,
  method         = CCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction  = "integrated.cca",
  verbose        = FALSE
)

# 4) Neighbors / clusters / UMAP on the integrated reduction
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.6)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.cca")
```




```{r}
saveRDS(obj, file = here("data/processed/integrated_seurat.rds"))
```

```{r}
plot_A <- DimPlot(integrated_obj,

                  reduction = "umap_res0.6", 
                  group.by = "condition",
                  cols = condition_colors, 
                  split.by = "condition",
                  label = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("B. UMAP Split by Condition (Visualizing Structure)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))




ggsave(plot = plot_A, filename = here("output/umap_by_condition.pdf"), height = 8, width = 10)
```

```{r}
markers_filtered <- all_cluster_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.25)

top_markers <- markers_filtered %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 50)

# convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
cluster_list <- split(top_markers$gene, top_markers$cluster)

enrich_results <- lapply(names(cluster_list), function(clust) {
  genes <- cluster_list[[clust]]
  genes_entrez <- bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
  
  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene         = genes_entrez$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
    ont          = "BP",
    readable     = TRUE,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 0.05
  )
  ego@result$Cluster <- clust
  return(ego@result)
})

# combine into one dataframe
enrich_df <- do.call(rbind, enrich_results)

```

## Label Transfer

```{r}
# --- File paths ---
integrated_obj_path <- here("data/processed/integrated_seurat.rds")
reference_matrix_path <- here("data/Filbin_GSE184357/counts_fresh_postFilter.txt") 
reference_metadata_path <- here("data/Filbin_GSE184357/metadata_fresh_postFilter.txt") 

reference_seurat_obj_output <- here("output/filbin_reference_seurat_obj.rds")
labeled_seurat_obj_output <- here("output/labeled_integrated_obj.rds") 
label_plot_output <- here("output/label_plot_raw.pdf")
score_plot_output <- here("output/score_plot.pdf")
violin_plot_output <- here("output/violin_plot.pdf")
confident_plot_output <- here("output/confident_plot.pdf")

# --- Parameters ---
dims <- 30
prediction_score_threshold <- 0.5
annotation_column <- "annotation"
filter_values <- c("G2M", "S") 
umap_width <- 12 
umap_height <- 10 

# --- Custom color palette for all labels ---
custom_palette <- c(
    "AC-like"     = "#1b9e77",  # dark teal
    "MES-like"    = "#d95f02",  # burnt orange
    "Microglia"   = "#7570b3",  # purple
    "OC-like"     = "#e7298a",  # pink
    "OPC-like-1"  = "#66a61e",  # green
    "OPC-like-2"  = "#e6ab02",  # yellow-orange
    "OPC-like-3"  = "#a6761d"   # brown
)

# --- Load Seurat object ---
integrated_obj <- readRDS(integrated_obj_path)

# --- Load reference ---
reference_matrix <- read.table(reference_matrix_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
reference_metadata <- read.table(reference_metadata_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)

reference <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = reference_matrix)
reference <- AddMetaData(reference, metadata = reference_metadata)

# --- Filter reference cells ---
if (length(filter_values) > 0) {
    cells_to_keep_anno <- !(reference@meta.data[[annotation_column]] %in% filter_values)
    reference <- subset(reference, cells = rownames(reference@meta.data)[cells_to_keep_anno])
}

# --- Shared genes ---
shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(reference), rownames(integrated_obj))

# --- SCTransform + PCA ---
reference <- SCTransform(reference, verbose = FALSE)
reference <- RunPCA(reference, verbose = FALSE, features = shared_genes)

# --- Save reference object ---
saveRDS(reference, reference_seurat_obj_output)

# --- Transfer anchors & labels ---
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = reference,
    query = integrated_obj, 
    dims = 1:dims,
    features = shared_genes,
    normalization.method = "SCT"
)

predicted_labels <- TransferData(
    anchorset = anchors,
    refdata = reference@meta.data[[annotation_column]], 
    dims = 1:dims
)

integrated_obj$transfered_labels <- predicted_labels$predicted.id
integrated_obj$transfered_label_score <- predicted_labels$prediction.score.max

# --- Assign confident labels ---
integrated_obj$transfered_labels_confident <- ifelse(
    integrated_obj$transfered_label_score >= prediction_score_threshold,
    integrated_obj$transfered_labels,
    "Uncertain"
)

# Factor levels: all observed labels + "Uncertain"
all_labels <- unique(integrated_obj$transfered_labels)
integrated_obj$transfered_labels_confident <- factor(
    integrated_obj$transfered_labels_confident,
    levels = c(all_labels, "Uncertain")
)

# --- DimPlot (raw labels) ---
p1 <- DimPlot(
    integrated_obj,
    group.by = "transfered_labels",
    label = FALSE,
    cols = custom_palette
) + ggtitle("Transferred Labels (Raw)") +
    theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

# --- FeaturePlot for prediction score ---
p2 <- FeaturePlot(
    integrated_obj,
    features = "transfered_label_score"
) + ggtitle("Prediction Score") +
    theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

# --- Violin plot by raw labels ---
p3 <- VlnPlot(
    integrated_obj,
    features = "transfered_label_score",
    group.by = "transfered_labels",
    cols = custom_palette
) + ggtitle("Prediction Score by Label") +
    theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

# --- DimPlot for confident labels ---
p4 <- DimPlot(
    integrated_obj,
    reduction = "umap_res0.6",
    group.by = "transfered_labels_confident",
    label = FALSE,
    cols = custom_palette
) + ggtitle("Confident Subtype Annotations") +
    theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

# --- Save plots ---
ggsave(label_plot_output, p1, width = umap_width, height = umap_height)
ggsave(score_plot_output, p2, width = umap_width, height = umap_height)
ggsave(violin_plot_output, p3, width = umap_width, height = umap_height)
ggsave(confident_plot_output, p4, width = umap_width, height = umap_height)


# Get all confident labels except "Uncertain"
all_labels <- setdiff(unique(integrated_obj$transfered_labels_confident), "Uncertain")

# --- Folder for individual UMAPs ---
output_umap_folder <- here("output/Individual_UMAPs")
if (!dir.exists(output_umap_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_umap_folder)
}


all_labels <- setdiff(unique(integrated_obj$transfered_labels_confident), "Uncertain")

# Loop through each label and save an individual UMAP to output/
for (lab in all_labels) {
  plot_file <- here("output", paste0("UMAP_", lab, ".pdf"))
  
  p <- DimPlot(
    integrated_obj,
    group.by = "transfered_labels_confident",
    cells.highlight = WhichCells(integrated_obj, expression = transfered_labels_confident == lab),
    sizes.highlight = 0.2,
    cols.highlight = custom_palette[lab],
    cols = "lightgrey"
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("UMAP for", lab)) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(plot_file, p, width = 8, height = 6)
}


# --- Save labeled Seurat object ---
saveRDS(integrated_obj, labeled_seurat_obj_output)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

# Prepare data
plot_data <- integrated_obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, transfered_labels_confident) %>%
  filter(transfered_labels_confident != "Uncertain") %>%
  group_by(condition, transfered_labels_confident) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Count = sum(Count),
    Proportion = Count / Total_Count,
    Percentage = Proportion * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Reorder subtypes within each condition by proportion (largest at bottom)
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  arrange(Percentage) %>%  # smallest first -> biggest at bottom
  mutate(
    transfered_labels_confident =
      factor(transfered_labels_confident,
             levels = unique(transfered_labels_confident))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Distinct color palette
custom_palette <- c(
    "AC-like"     = "#1b9e77",  # dark teal
    "MES-like"    = "#d95f02",  # burnt orange
    "Microglia"   = "#7570b3",  # purple
    "OC-like"     = "#e7298a",  # pink
    "OPC-like-1"  = "#66a61e",  # green
    "OPC-like-2"  = "#e6ab02",  # yellow-orange
    "OPC-like-3"  = "#a6761d"   # brown
)

# --- Reorder conditions for plotting ---
plot_data$condition <- factor(
  plot_data$condition,
  levels = c("NS","BP_Control", "BP_Cues")  
)

# Plot
p_dist <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = condition,
    y = Percentage,
    fill = transfered_labels_confident,
    group = interaction(condition, transfered_labels_confident),  # <- add
    order = -Percentage                                          # <- add
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Confident Subtypes Across Conditions",
       x = "Condition", y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Subtype") +
  theme_pubr() + theme(legend.position = "right")

# Save to output/
ggsave(here("output/stacked_barplot_distribution.pdf"), p_dist, width = 8, height = 6)


```

##Cell Cycle Scoring

```{r}
integrated_obj <- CellCycleScoring(
  integrated_obj,
  s.features   = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes,
  g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes,
  set.ident    = FALSE
)

phase_dim_plot <- DimPlot(integrated_obj, group.by = "Phase") +
  ggtitle("Cell cycle phase across all cells") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    G1  = "#999999",
    S   = "#56B4E9",
    G2M = "#E69F00"
  ))

FeaturePlot(integrated_obj, features = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))

# Calculate phase proportions per condition
phase_counts <- prop.table(table(integrated_obj$Phase, integrated_obj$condition), 2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Phase = Var1, Condition = Var2, Proportion = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("NS", "BP_Control", "BP_Cueswha")),
    label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Proportion * 100)   # format labels
  )

# Barplot with percentage labels inside bars
phase_barplot <- ggplot(phase_counts, aes(x = Condition, y = Proportion, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),  # centers labels within stacks
            color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(G1="#999999", S="#56B4E9", G2M="#E69F00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Cell-cycle composition across conditions",
    x = NULL, y = "Fraction of cells", fill = "Phase"
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(phase_dim_plot, filename = here("output/cell_cycle_phase_umap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave(phase_barplot, filename = here("output/cell_cycle_phase_barplot.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
meta <- integrated_obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    state   = transfered_labels_confident,
    cycling = Phase %in% c("S", "G2M")
  ) %>%
  filter(state != "Uncertain")

by_state <- meta %>%
  group_by(state, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    n_cycl    = sum(cycling),
    frac_cycl = n_cycl / n,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

by_state$condition <- factor(by_state$condition,
                             levels = c("NS", "BP_Control", "BP_Cues"))

# >>> set your desired order here <<<

                 "OPC-like-1",
                 "OPC-like-2",
                 "OPC-like-3",
                 "AC-like",
                 "OC-like")
by_state$state <- factor(by_state$state, levels = state_order)

cycling_fraction_by_state <- ggplot(by_state, aes(state, frac_cycl, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", width = 0.7) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "% cycling (S+G2M)", fill = "Condition",
       title = "Cycling fraction within each predicted state") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))

ggsave(cycling_fraction_by_state,
       filename = here("output/cycling_fraction_by_state.pdf"),
       width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(dplyr); library(readxl); library(here); library(ggplot2); library(tidyr)
})

# --- Load module table ---
modules_scores <- read_xlsx(here("data/Filbin_GSE184357/module_scores.xlsx"), skip = 3)

wanted_modules <- c("MES1","MES2","AC","OPC","NPC1","NPC2")
modules_scores <- modules_scores %>% dplyr::select(any_of(wanted_modules))

# --- Build vectors per module, keep only genes present ---
genes_in_obj <- rownames(integrated_obj)
module_list <- lapply(modules_scores, function(col) {
  intersect(unique(na.omit(as.character(col))), genes_in_obj)
})
names(module_list) <- colnames(modules_scores)

# Drop tiny sets and show a quick QC
module_list_present <- module_list[sapply(module_list, length) >= 5]
stopifnot(length(module_list_present) > 0)
cat("Genes per module (in object):\n")
print(sapply(module_list_present, length))

# (Optional) stash for reproducibility
integrated_obj@misc$filbin_gene_sets <- module_list_present

# --- Remove ONLY previous score columns to avoid clutter ---
score_name_regex <- paste0("^(", paste(names(module_list_present), collapse="|"), ")(\\d+)?$")
keep_cols <- setdiff(colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data),
                     grep(score_name_regex, colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE))
integrated_obj@meta.data <- integrated_obj@meta.data[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- Score modules (explicit assay + seed + ctrl) ---
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
set.seed(123)  # reproducible background selection
for (m in names(module_list_present)) {
  integrated_obj <- AddModuleScore(
    integrated_obj,
    features = list(module_list_present[[m]]),
    name = m,                  # produces m1
    nbin = 24,                 # default bins
    ctrl = 100,                # default control genes per bin; explicit = reproducible
    assay = "RNA",
    seed = TRUE
  )
  old <- paste0(m, "1")
  if (old %in% colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data)) {
    colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data)[match(old, colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))] <- m
  }
}

# --- Violin data ---
meta <- integrated_obj@meta.data
score_cols <- intersect(names(module_list_present), colnames(meta))
stopifnot(length(score_cols) > 0)

# (Optional) consistent condition order
# integrated_obj$condition <- factor(integrated_obj$condition, levels = c("NS","BP_Control","BP_Cues"))

plot_df <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, dplyr::all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(score_cols),
                      names_to = "module", values_to = "score")

# --- Violin plot (raw module scores) ---
p_violin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = score, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 0.9, color = "black") +

  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

       p_violin, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in")
```

```{r}
pairs <- combn(conds, 2, simplify = FALSE)
res_list <- list()

for (pp in pairs) {
  c1 <- pp[1]; c2 <- pp[2]

  obj_pair <- subset(integrated_obj, subset = condition %in% c(c1, c2))
  if (ncol(obj_pair) < 50) next  # avoid tiny comparisons

  Idents(obj_pair) <- "condition"

  de <- FindMarkers(
    obj_pair,
    ident.1 = c2, ident.2 = c1,     # 'avg_log2FC' > 0 => higher in c2
    assay = "RNA",
    test.use = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold = 0,            # keep all; you can filter later
    min.pct = 0.05,
    only.pos = FALSE
  )

  de <- de %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      contrast  = paste0(c2, "_vs_", c1),
      direction = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, paste0("up in ", c2),
                  ifelse(avg_log2FC < 0, paste0("up in ", c1), "tie"))
    ) %>%
    relocate(contrast, gene)

  fn <- file.path(outdir, paste0("DE_cells_", c2, "_vs_", c1, ".csv"))
  write.csv(de, fn, row.names = FALSE)
  res_list[[paste(c1, c2, sep="|")]] <- de
}

# Combined table
if (length(res_list)) {
  de_all <- bind_rows(res_list)
  write.csv(de_all, file.path(outdir, "DE_cells_ALL_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## GSEA analysis 

```{r}

```


```{r}
# ============================
# Stand-alone Hallmark GSEA (clusterProfiler) — CSV + DOTPLOT + NES BARPLOT
# (EMT/APICAL enrichment-curve section removed)
# Requires: res_list (list of DE data.frames with columns: gene, avg_log2FC[, contrast])
# ============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler); library(msigdbr)
  library(enrichplot)         # for dotplot()
  library(ggplot2); library(ggpubr)
  library(here); library(readr)
})

set.seed(123)

# ---- Helpers ----
safe_filename <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

# ---- Hallmark gene sets ----
# Use 'category' (correct arg); SYMBOLs already in msigdbr output
msig_h_tbl <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
stopifnot(nrow(msig_h_tbl) > 0)

TERM2GENE <- msig_h_tbl %>%
  transmute(gs_name, gene_symbol = toupper(trimws(gene_symbol)))

# ---- GSEA runner for a single DE table ----
run_cp_gsea_on_de <- function(de_df, contrast,
                              TERM2GENE,
                              out_dir = here("output","gsea_cp","conditions_from_cells"),
                              minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
                              pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "BH") {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Clean & prep ranked list
  dd <- de_df %>%
    mutate(gene = toupper(trimws(gene))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), is.finite(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (!nrow(dd)) {
    readr::write_lines("# Empty: no genes after cleaning",
      file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA_cp_", safe_filename(contrast), "_Hallmark.csv")))
    message("No genes after cleaning for ", contrast)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  geneList <- dd$avg_log2FC; names(geneList) <- dd$gene
  geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

  # Run GSEA
  gsea_res <- GSEA(
    geneList = geneList,
    TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
    pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
    pAdjustMethod = pAdjustMethod,
    minGSSize = minGSSize,
    maxGSSize = maxGSSize,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA_cp_", safe_filename(contrast), "_Hallmark.csv"))
  if (is.null(gsea_res) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_res)) == 0) {
    readr::write_lines("# Empty: no enriched Hallmark sets", out_csv)
    message("No enriched pathways for ", contrast)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
  readr::write_csv(res_df, out_csv)

  # ---------- NES BARPLOT (Top 15 by FDR, ordered by NES) ----------
  topN <- 15
  res_top <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      # clean up names
      Description = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", Description),
      Description = gsub("_", " ", Description),
      padj = p.adjust
    ) %>%
    slice_min(padj, n = topN, with_ties = FALSE)

  # order: positive NES (up) at top, most negative (down) at bottom
  ord <- res_top %>%
    arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))

  p_bar <- ggplot(ord, aes(x = NES, y = Description)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = padj), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
    # smooth blue–white–red scale: red = low FDR (strong), blue = high FDR
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
      name = expression(p.adjust),
      trans = "reverse",
      guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 1.1, barheight = 7)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Hallmark GSEA — ", contrast),
      subtitle = "Upregulated (high NES) at top; downregulated (low NES) at bottom. Color = FDR.",
      x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    ggpubr::theme_pubr(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA_cp_barplot_", safe_filename(contrast), ".pdf")),
         p_bar, width = 8, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)

  # ---------- Overview DOTPLOT (top 15) ----------
  gsea_res@result$Description <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", gsea_res@result$Description)
  p_dot <- dotplot(gsea_res, showCategory = 15) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Hallmark GSEA (clusterProfiler) — ", contrast))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA_cp_dotplot_", safe_filename(contrast), ".pdf")),
         p_dot, width = 10, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)

  invisible(res_df)
}

# ---- Run across your res_list ----
out_dir_cp <- here("output","gsea_cp","conditions_from_cells")
dir.create(out_dir_cp, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(exists("res_list"), length(res_list) > 0)

purrr::iwalk(res_list, function(de_df, key) {
  contrast <- if ("contrast" %in% names(de_df)) unique(na.omit(de_df$contrast))[1] else {
    parts <- strsplit(key, "\\|")[[1]]  # if your key was "c1|c2"
    if (length(parts) == 2) paste0(parts[2], "_vs_", parts[1]) else as.character(key)
  }
  message("\n=== Hallmark GSEA: ", contrast, " ===",
          "\nNES>0 = enriched in FIRST term of '", contrast, "' (your c2)")

  run_cp_gsea_on_de(de_df, contrast, TERM2GENE, out_dir = out_dir_cp,
                    minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500)
})

message("Done. GSEA outputs in: ", out_dir_cp)


```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(enrichplot); library(ggplot2); library(ggpubr); library(here) })

# Use the SAME gsea_res you just inspected
stopifnot(exists("gsea_res"))

out_dir <- here("output","gsea_cp","emt_apical_gseaplot2_final")

targets <- c("HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION",
             "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION")

plot_one <- function(gs_id, contrast_label = NULL) {
  # pull NES/FDR from this gsea_res so labels match
  df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res)
  row <- df[df$ID == gs_id, , drop = FALSE]
  NES_txt <- sprintf("%.2f", row$NES[1])
  FDR_txt <- formatC(row$p.adjust[1], format = "e", digits = 2)

  title_main <- sub("^HALLMARK_", "", gs_id)
  subtitle   <- paste0("NES = ", NES_txt, " | FDR = ", FDR_txt,
                       if (!is.null(contrast_label)) paste0(" | ", contrast_label) else "")

  p <- enrichplot::gseaplot2(
    gsea_res,
    geneSetID = gs_id,      # exact ID shown in your object
    subplots  = 1:3,
    base_size = 12
  ) +
    ggtitle(title_main, subtitle = subtitle) +
    ggpubr::theme_pubr(base_size = 14) +
    labs(x = "Ranked genes", y = "Running enrichment score") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40")

  fn_stub <- paste0("gseaplot2_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+","_", gs_id),
                    if (!is.null(contrast_label)) paste0("_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+","_", contrast_label)) else "")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(fn_stub, ".pdf")), p, width = 8, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(fn_stub, ".png")), p, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, paste0(fn_stub, ".pdf")))
}

# If you have a contrast string, pass it; otherwise omit
contrast_label <- NULL  # e.g., "BP_Cues_vs_BP_Control"

lapply(targets, plot_one, contrast_label = contrast_label)
```

## GSEA by cell state

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(readr)
  library(clusterProfiler); library(msigdbr); library(ggplot2); library(here)
})

# --- detect label column you use everywhere ---
label_col <- if ("transferred_labels_confident" %in% colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))
  "transferred_labels_confident" else "transfered_labels_confident"

# --- make sure RNA layers are joined (Seurat v5 safety) ---
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
if ("layers" %in% slotNames(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])) {
  integrated_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])
}

conds  <- levels(factor(integrated_obj$condition))
states <- integrated_obj@meta.data[[label_col]] |> as.character() |> unique() |> na.omit() |> sort()

# ---- Hallmark TERM2GENE (SYMBOL) ----
msig_h_tbl <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
TERM2GENE  <- msig_h_tbl %>% transmute(gs_name, gene_symbol = toupper(trimws(gene_symbol)))
safe_filename <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

# ---- small helper: run CP::GSEA exactly like your global step ----
run_cp_gsea_on_de <- function(de_df, contrast, term2gene, out_dir,
                              minGSSize=10, maxGSSize=500, pvalueCutoff=1, pAdjustMethod="BH") {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  dd <- de_df %>%
    mutate(gene = toupper(trimws(gene))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), is.finite(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all=TRUE)
  geneList <- dd$avg_log2FC; names(geneList) <- dd$gene
  geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea_res <- GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = term2gene,
                   minGSSize=minGSSize, maxGSSize=maxGSSize,
                   pvalueCutoff=pvalueCutoff, pAdjustMethod=pAdjustMethod, verbose=FALSE)

  out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA_cp_", safe_filename(contrast), "_Hallmark.csv"))
  if (is.null(gsea_res) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_res))==0) {
    write_lines("# Empty: no enriched Hallmark sets", out_csv); return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
  write_csv(res_df, out_csv)
  invisible(res_df)
}

# ---- run DE + GSEA per state and contrast ----
pairs <- combn(conds, 2, simplify = FALSE)
out_dir_ws <- here("output","gsea_cp","within_state")
dir.create(out_dir_ws, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

nes_rows <- list()

for (st in states) {
  obj_st <- subset(integrated_obj, subset = !!as.name(label_col) == st)
  if (ncol(obj_st) < 50) next
  Idents(obj_st) <- "condition"

  for (pp in pairs) {
    c1 <- pp[1]; c2 <- pp[2]
    if (sum(obj_st$condition %in% c(c1,c2)) < 30) next

    de <- FindMarkers(
      subset(obj_st, subset = condition %in% c(c1,c2)),
      ident.1 = c2, ident.2 = c1,
      assay = "RNA", test.use = "wilcox",
      logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.05, only.pos = FALSE
    ) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      mutate(contrast = paste0(c2, "_vs_", c1),
             state = st) %>% relocate(state, contrast, gene)

    contrast <- unique(de$contrast)
    res <- run_cp_gsea_on_de(
      de_df = de, contrast = paste0(st, "__", contrast),
      term2gene = TERM2GENE, out_dir = out_dir_ws
    )
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      nes_rows[[length(nes_rows)+1]] <- res %>%
        dplyr::select(ID, NES, p.adjust) %>%
        mutate(state = st, contrast = contrast)
    }
  }
}

nes_tab <- dplyr::bind_rows(nes_rows)
readr::write_csv(nes_tab, file.path(out_dir_ws, "NES_summary_within_state.csv"))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2); library(here); library(msigdbr); library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================
# 0) Setup / safety
# =========================
label_col <- if ("transferred_labels_confident" %in% colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))
  "transferred_labels_confident" else "transfered_labels_confident"

DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
if ("layers" %in% slotNames(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])) {
  integrated_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])
}

# Conditions
conds  <- levels(factor(integrated_obj$condition))

# Drop labels you don't want
bad_states <- c("Uncertain", "UNCERTAIN", "Unknown")

# Output dir
out_dir <- here("output","module_scores_hallmarks")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =========================
# 1) Get Hallmark gene sets
# =========================
targets <- c("HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
             "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",
             "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION")

# map canonical -> pretty names
score_keys <- c(
  HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB = "TNFA_NFKB",
  HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION = "EMT",
  HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION = "APICAL_JUNCTION"
)

msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  filter(gs_name %in% targets) %>%
  transmute(gs_name, gene_symbol = toupper(trimws(gene_symbol)))

# Map MSigDB symbols to the symbols present in your object (case-safe)
obj_genes_upper <- toupper(rownames(integrated_obj))
map_back <- setNames(rownames(integrated_obj), obj_genes_upper)

gene_list_raw <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)
gene_list_mapped <- lapply(gene_list_raw, function(v){
  v <- intersect(v, names(map_back))
  unique(unname(map_back[v]))
})
gene_list_mapped <- gene_list_mapped[lengths(gene_list_mapped) > 0]  # drop empties

# For AddModuleScore we need an unnamed list; but we keep names to align later
features_list <- unname(gene_list_mapped)
pretty_base   <- unname(score_keys[names(gene_list_mapped)])  # e.g. c("TNFA_NFKB","EMT","APICAL_JUNCTION")

# =========================
# 2) Add per-cell module scores (idempotent + safe)
# =========================
# 2a) remove any previous runs to avoid duplicate-name issues
old_generic <- grep("^HMK_", colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
old_pretty  <- grep("_(score)$", colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
cols_to_drop <- unique(c(old_generic, old_pretty))
if (length(cols_to_drop)) {
  integrated_obj@meta.data <- integrated_obj@meta.data[, setdiff(colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data), cols_to_drop), drop = FALSE]
}

# 2b) add scores and capture new columns
pre_cols <- colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data)
integrated_obj <- AddModuleScore(
  object   = integrated_obj,
  features = features_list,
  name     = "HMK_"  # Seurat appends numbers
)
post_cols <- colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data)
new_cols  <- setdiff(post_cols, pre_cols)
stopifnot(length(new_cols) == length(features_list))

# Rename new cols to pretty names in the same order as features_list/gene_list_mapped
pretty_names <- paste0(pretty_base, "_score")
colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data)[match(new_cols, colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))] <- pretty_names
score_cols <- pretty_names

# =========================
# 3) Filter out "Uncertain" and build summaries
# =========================
# states to keep (trim whitespace)
states <- integrated_obj@meta.data[[label_col]] |>
  as.character() |>
  trimws() |>
  setdiff(bad_states) |>
  na.omit() |>
  sort()

# meta with scores and labels (filtered)
meta <- integrated_obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, condition, !!label_col, dplyr::all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(state = !!label_col) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = trimws(as.character(state))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(state), state %in% states) %>%
  droplevels()

# mean ± sd per state × condition × score
sum_long <- meta %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(score_cols), names_to = "score", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state, condition, score) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                   mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

readr::write_csv(sum_long, file.path(out_dir, "module_scores_state_by_condition_means.csv"))

# =========================
# 4) Heatmap: mean scores (states × score•condition)
# =========================
heat_mat <- sum_long %>%
  tidyr::unite("score_cond", score, condition, sep = " • ") %>%
  dplyr::select(state, score_cond, mean) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = score_cond, values_from = mean) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("state") %>%
  as.matrix()

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "ModuleScore_Heatmap_states_by_score_condition.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(heat_mat, name = "mean score",
                        cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE,
                        column_title = "Hallmark module scores by condition",
                        row_title = "Cell state")
dev.off()

# =========================
# 5) Violins: per score, grouped by state, faceted by condition
# =========================
p_violin <- meta %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(score_cols), names_to = "score", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = factor(score, levels = paste0(pretty_base, "_score"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = state, y = value, fill = state)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition + score, ncol = length(conds), scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cell state", y = "Module score",
       title = "Hallmark module scores by state and condition")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "ModuleScore_violins_by_state_condition.pdf"),
       p_violin, width = 12, height = 7)

# =========================
# 6) Top-20% contributors: which states dominate high scorers?
# =========================
top_contrib <- meta %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(score_cols), names_to = "score", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(score) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(thresh = quantile(value, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
                high = value >= thresh) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(high) %>%
  dplyr::count(score, condition, state, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(score, condition) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(frac_within_condition = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(top_contrib, file.path(out_dir, "Top20pct_contributors_by_state.csv"))

p_bar <- top_contrib %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = factor(score, levels = paste0(pretty_base, "_score"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = frac_within_condition, fill = state)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ score, ncol = length(pretty_base)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Share of high-scoring cells",
       title = "Which states contribute the top 20% module scores?") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Top20pct_contributors_stacked_bar.pdf"),
       p_bar, width = 10, height = 5)

# =========================
# 7) UMAP overlays of per-cell module scores (split by condition)
#     (also excluding Uncertain by subsetting the object for plotting)
# =========================
# cells to keep (no "Uncertain")
keep_cells <- WhichCells(
  integrated_obj,
  expression = trimws(as.character(get(label_col))) %in% states
)

# make a lightweight plotting object with UMAP but NO graphs
obj_plot <- DietSeurat(
  integrated_obj,
  assays    = DefaultAssay(integrated_obj),
  counts    = FALSE,   # we only need data slot for FeaturePlot
  data      = TRUE,
  scale.data= FALSE,
  dimreducs = "umap",
  graphs    = FALSE    # <-- drop graphs to avoid as.Graph() error
)

# subset safely (no graph conversion now)
obj_no_uncertain <- subset(obj_plot, cells = keep_cells)

# proceed with the UMAP overlays
for (feat in score_cols) {
  p <- FeaturePlot(
    obj_no_uncertain, features = feat, split.by = "condition",
    reduction = "umap", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3
  ) + ggtitle(paste0(feat, " (per-cell)"))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("UMAP_", feat, "_split_by_condition.pdf")),
         p, width = 12, height = 4.5)
}


# =========================
# 8) Delta tiles — mean score shifts between conditions, per state
# =========================
contrasts <- list(
  "BP_Control - NS" = c("NS","BP_Control"),
  "BP_Cues - NS"    = c("NS","BP_Cues"),
  "BP_Cues - BP_Control" = c("BP_Control","BP_Cues")
)

delta_long <- lapply(names(contrasts), function(lbl){
  c1 <- contrasts[[lbl]][1]; c2 <- contrasts[[lbl]][2]
  sum_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(condition %in% c(c1,c2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(state, condition, score, mean) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(delta = .data[[c2]] - .data[[c1]], contrast = lbl)
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

p_delta <- delta_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = factor(score, levels = score_cols)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = state, fill = delta)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B") +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() + labs(x = "Hallmark module", y = "Cell state",
                    fill = "Δ mean\n(score)",
                    title = "Within-state shifts in module scores (c2 - c1)")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "ModuleScore_delta_tiles_by_state.pdf"),
       p_delta, width = 12, height = 5.2)

# =========================
# 9) State rankings (per condition) — lollipop view
# =========================
rank_df <- sum_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition, score) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean, .by_group = TRUE) %>%

p_lolli <- rank_df %>%

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "ModuleScore_state_rank_lollipops.pdf"),
       p_lolli, width = 12, height = 8)

# =========================

stopifnot(all(c("EMT_score","TNFA_NFKB_score") %in% score_cols))
p_scatter <- meta %>%
```

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggbeeswarm)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(here)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ------------------------------------------------------------
keep_states <- c("MES-like", "OPC-like-1")
score_cols  <- c("EMT_score", "TNFA_NFKB_score", "APICAL_JUNCTION_score")

cond_cols <- c(
  NS = "#808080",
  BP_Control = "#0072B2",
  BP_Cues = "#D55E00"
)

use_mean <- TRUE
central_fun  <- if (use_mean) mean else median
central_name <- if (use_mean) "mean" else "median"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
long_df <- meta %>%
  filter(state %in% keep_states) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(score_cols), names_to = "Program", values_to = "Score")

long_df$condition <- factor(long_df$condition, levels = names(cond_cols))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output directory
# ------------------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("output")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_safe <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Loop for individual plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------
for (st in keep_states) {
  for (pg in score_cols) {
    df_sub <- long_df %>% filter(state == st, Program == pg)

    # dynamically tighten Y-axis range (adds mild zoom but honest)
    rng   <- range(df_sub$Score, na.rm = TRUE)
    span  <- diff(rng)
    pad   <- 0.15 * span             # 15% padding instead of full range
    ylims <- c(rng[1] - pad, rng[2] + pad)

    p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Score, fill = condition)) +
      geom_violin(width = 0.8, trim = TRUE, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.7) +  # slightly wider
      geom_quasirandom(aes(color = condition),
                       width = 0.22, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.55, stroke = 0) +
      stat_summary(
        fun = central_fun,
        aes(group = condition),
        geom = "crossbar",
        width = 0.3,
        fatten = 0.6,
        color = "black",
        size = 1
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cond_cols) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = ylims) +  
      theme_pubr() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
        axis.title  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.3),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Condition",
        y = "Module score",
        title = paste0(pg, " — ", st),
        subtitle = paste("Horizontal line =", central_name)
      )

    outfile <- here(out_dir, paste0("Violin_", file_safe(st), "_", file_safe(pg), ".pdf"))
    ggsave(outfile, p, width = 6, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
state_col <- "transfered_labels_confident"

# Remove zero-variance genes/columns to avoid prcomp crash

# ---- 4) Plot function: scatter per pair (labels ON for red topN) ----
plot_scatter_pair_builtin <- function(
  obj, cond1, cond2,
  topN = 10,
  rank_metric = c("abs_logFC", "logFC"),
  min_mean = 0,
  show_corr = TRUE,
  corr_method = c("pearson","spearman"),
  label_top = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.25,
  pt.alpha = 0.5,
  top_pt.size = 1.0,
  top_pt.alpha = 0.95,
  top_pt.col = "firebrick",
  label_size = 3,
  line_size_top = 0.3,
  seed = 123
) {
  rank_metric <- match.arg(rank_metric)
  corr_method <- match.arg(corr_method)
  set.seed(seed)

  # Seurat v5-friendly extraction
  if (inherits(obj, "Seurat")) {
    M <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj[["RNA"]], layer = "data"))
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    M <- obj
  } else stop("obj must be a Seurat object or matrix (genes x samples).")

  stopifnot(all(c(cond1, cond2) %in% colnames(M)))

  df <- data.frame(
    x = M[, cond1],
    y = M[, cond2],
    gene = rownames(M),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df <- df[complete.cases(df$x, df$y), , drop = FALSE]
  df$mean_xy <- rowMeans(df[, c("x","y"), drop = FALSE])
  if (min_mean > 0) df <- df[df$mean_xy >= min_mean, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No genes left after filtering (try lower 'min_mean').")

  df$delta <- df$y - df$x
  score    <- if (rank_metric == "abs_logFC") abs(df$delta) else df$delta
  ord      <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  top_genes <- df$gene[head(ord, topN)]

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(size = pt.size, alpha = pt.alpha, color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(df, gene %in% top_genes),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = top_pt.col, size = top_pt.size, alpha = top_pt.alpha
    ) +
    xlab(paste0(cond1, " (log expr)")) +
    ylab(paste0(cond2, " (log expr)")) +
    ggtitle(paste0(cond2, " vs ", cond1)) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  if (show_corr) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df$x, df$y, method = corr_method))
    lab <- sprintf("%s r = %.3f (p = %.2g)",
                   tools::toTitleCase(corr_method), unname(ct$estimate), ct$p.value)
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, label = lab)
  }

  if (label_top && length(top_genes) > 0) {
    df_top <- subset(df, gene %in% top_genes)
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df_top,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene),
      color = top_pt.col, size = label_size,
      segment.size = line_size_top,
      box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2,
      force = 2, max.overlaps = Inf
    )
  }
  p
}

# ---- 5) CSV writer for most-different genes per pair ----
write_pair_diff_csv <- function(
  obj, cond1, cond2,
  out_dir    = "output/global_scatter",
  topK       = 100,
  min_mean   = 0,
  rank_by    = c("abs_lnFC","lnFC"),
  write_full = TRUE
) {
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)

  # Extract matrix (genes x samples)
  M <- if (inherits(obj, "Seurat")) {
    as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj[["RNA"]], layer = "data"))
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    obj
  } else stop("obj must be a Seurat object or matrix (genes x samples).")

  stopifnot(all(c(cond1, cond2) %in% colnames(M)))

  # Build per-gene table
  df <- data.frame(
    gene     = rownames(M),
    x_log    = M[, cond1],
    y_log    = M[, cond2],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df <- df[complete.cases(df$x_log, df$y_log), , drop = FALSE]
  df$mean_log <- rowMeans(df[, c("x_log","y_log")], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (min_mean > 0) df <- df[df$mean_log >= min_mean, , drop = FALSE]

  # Differences and rankings
  df$lnFC     <- df$y_log - df$x_log
  df$abs_lnFC <- abs(df$lnFC)
  df$log2FC   <- df$lnFC / log(2)
  df$FC       <- exp(df$lnFC)
  df$direction <- ifelse(df$lnFC > 0, paste0("up in ", cond2),
                         ifelse(df$lnFC < 0, paste0("up in ", cond1), "tie"))

  ord_col <- if (rank_by == "abs_lnFC") "abs_lnFC" else "lnFC"
  df <- df[order(df[[ord_col]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))

  # Order columns (without 'contrast'; caller will add it)
  df <- df[, c("rank","gene","x_log","y_log","mean_log",
               "lnFC","abs_lnFC","log2FC","FC","direction")]

  # Write files
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  short_name <- paste0("TOP", topK, "_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")
  full_name  <- paste0("ALL_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")

  write.csv(head(df, topK), file.path(out_dir, short_name), row.names = FALSE)
  if (write_full) write.csv(df, file.path(out_dir, full_name), row.names = FALSE)

  invisible(df)
}


# ---- 6) Generate all pairwise plots + CSVs + combined table ----

  g <- plot_scatter_pair_builtin(

  )

message("Done. Outputs in ./output and ./output/global_scatter")
```

```{r}
# --- helper to compute & write "most different genes" tables ---
write_pair_diff_csv <- function(
  obj, cond1, cond2,
  out_dir   = "output/global_scatter",
  topK      = 100,                 # how many to export in the top file
  min_mean  = 0,                   # filter tiny/noisy genes by mean log expr
  rank_by   = c("abs_lnFC","lnFC"),# ranking metric
  write_full = TRUE                # also write the full (unfiltered) table
) {
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)

  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, slot = "data"))  # log-normalized (ln scale)
  stopifnot(all(c(cond1, cond2) %in% colnames(mat)))

  df <- data.frame(
    gene   = rownames(mat),
    x_log  = mat[, cond1],
    y_log  = mat[, cond2],
    mean_log = rowMeans(mat[, c(cond1, cond2), drop = FALSE]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (min_mean > 0) df <- df[df$mean_log >= min_mean, , drop = FALSE]

  # Differences on log scale
  df$lnFC     <- df$y_log - df$x_log                   # natural log fold-change
  df$abs_lnFC <- abs(df$lnFC)
  df$log2FC   <- df$lnFC / log(2)                      # convert to log2
  df$FC       <- exp(df$lnFC)                          # linear fold-change
  df$direction <- ifelse(df$lnFC > 0, paste0("up in ", cond2),
                         ifelse(df$lnFC < 0, paste0("up in ", cond1), "tie"))

  # order & rank
  ord_col <- if (rank_by == "abs_lnFC") "abs_lnFC" else "lnFC"
  df <- df[order(df[[ord_col]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))

  # nice column order
  df <- df[, c("rank","gene",
               "x_log","y_log","mean_log",
               "lnFC","abs_lnFC","log2FC","FC","direction")]

  # write CSVs
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  short_name <- paste0("TOP", topK, "_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")
  full_name  <- paste0("ALL_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")
  utils::write.csv(head(df, topK),
                   file = file.path(out_dir, short_name), row.names = FALSE)
  if (write_full) {
    utils::write.csv(df, file = file.path(out_dir, full_name), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(df)
}
```

```{r}
# ---- Input object & identities ----

cor_spea <- cor(mat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  ct_s <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman"))

    cond1 = pp[1], cond2 = pp[2],
    n_genes = sum(complete.cases(x, y)),
    pearson_r = unname(ct_p$estimate),
    pearson_p = ct_p$p.value,
    spearman_r = unname(ct_s$estimate),
    spearman_p = ct_s$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}, simplify = FALSE))
write.csv(pairs_tab, "output/Global_pairwise_correlations.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Helper: remove 45° line from CellScatter ----
.rm_abline <- function(p) {
  keep <- vapply(p$layers, function(L) !inherits(L$geom, "GeomAbline"), logical(1))
  p$layers <- p$layers[keep]
  p
}

# ---- 4) Built-in style scatter plot with LabelPoints ----
plot_scatter_pair_builtin <- function(
  obj, cond1, cond2,
  topN = 10,
  rank_metric = c("abs_logFC", "logFC"),
  min_mean = 0,
  show_corr = TRUE,
  corr_method = c("pearson","spearman"),
  label_top = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.2,
  pt.alpha = 0.5,
  top_pt.size = 0.8,
  top_pt.alpha = 0.95,
  top_pt.col = "firebrick",
  line_size_top = 0.2,
  seed = 123
) {
  rank_metric <- match.arg(rank_metric)
  corr_method <- match.arg(corr_method)
  set.seed(seed)

  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, slot = "data"))
  stopifnot(all(c(cond1, cond2) %in% colnames(mat)))

  df <- data.frame(
    x = mat[, cond1],
    y = mat[, cond2],
    gene = rownames(mat),
    mean_xy = rowMeans(mat[, c(cond1, cond2), drop = FALSE]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (min_mean > 0) df <- df[df$mean_xy >= min_mean, , drop = FALSE]

  df$delta <- df$y - df$x
  score <- if (rank_metric == "abs_logFC") abs(df$delta) else df$delta
  ord <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  top_genes <- df$gene[head(ord, topN)]

  # Base plot with CellScatter and top genes highlighted
  p <- CellScatter(obj, cond1, cond2, highlight = top_genes)
  p <- .rm_abline(p)
  p <- p + ggtitle(paste0(cond2, " vs ", cond1)) +
    xlab(paste0(cond1, " (log expr)")) +
    ylab(paste0(cond2, " (log expr)")) +
    theme_cowplot() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  # Make base dots smaller and more transparent
  if (length(p$layers) >= 1) {
    p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size  <- pt.size
    p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha <- pt.alpha
  }

  # Overplot red points for top genes
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = subset(df, gene %in% top_genes),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = top_pt.size, alpha = top_pt.alpha, color = top_pt.col
  )

  # Add correlation label
  if (show_corr) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df$x, df$y, method = corr_method))
    lab <- sprintf("%s r = %.3f (p = %.2g)",
                   tools::toTitleCase(corr_method), ct$estimate, ct$p.value)
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, label = lab)
  }

  # Add gene labels with repel
  if (label_top) {
    p <- LabelPoints(plot = p, points = top_genes, repel = TRUE)
    # Make repel lines thinner
    p$layers[[length(p$layers)]]$geom_params$segment.size <- line_size_top
  }

  p
}

# ---- 5) Write per-pair CSVs for top differential genes ----
write_pair_diff_csv <- function(
  obj, cond1, cond2,
  out_dir = "output/global_scatter",
  topK = 100,
  min_mean = 0,
  rank_by = c("abs_lnFC","lnFC"),
  write_full = TRUE
) {
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)
  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, slot = "data"))
  stopifnot(all(c(cond1, cond2) %in% colnames(mat)))

  df <- data.frame(
    gene     = rownames(mat),
    x_log    = mat[, cond1],
    y_log    = mat[, cond2],
    mean_log = rowMeans(mat[, c(cond1, cond2), drop = FALSE]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (min_mean > 0) df <- df[df$mean_log >= min_mean, , drop = FALSE]

  df$lnFC      <- df$y_log - df$x_log
  df$abs_lnFC  <- abs(df$lnFC)
  df$log2FC    <- df$lnFC / log(2)
  df$FC        <- exp(df$lnFC)
  df$direction <- ifelse(df$lnFC > 0, paste0("up in ", cond2),
                         ifelse(df$lnFC < 0, paste0("up in ", cond1), "tie"))
  ord_col <- if (rank_by == "abs_lnFC") "abs_lnFC" else "lnFC"
  df <- df[order(df[[ord_col]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  df <- df[, c("rank","gene","x_log","y_log","mean_log","lnFC","abs_lnFC","log2FC","FC","direction")]

  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  short_name <- paste0("TOP", topK, "_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")
  full_name  <- paste0("ALL_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".csv")
  write.csv(head(df, topK), file.path(out_dir, short_name), row.names = FALSE)
  if (write_full) write.csv(df, file.path(out_dir, full_name), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(df)
}

# ---- 6) Generate all pairwise plots and CSVs ----
dir.create("output/global_scatter", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pairs <- combn(colnames(agg_cond), 2, simplify = FALSE)
all_pairs <- lapply(pairs, function(pp) {
  cond1 <- pp[1]; cond2 <- pp[2]
  g <- plot_scatter_pair_builtin(
    obj = agg_cond, cond1 = cond1, cond2 = cond2,
    topN = 10, rank_metric = "abs_logFC",
    min_mean = 0.1, show_corr = TRUE, corr_method = "pearson", label_top = TRUE
  )
  gfile <- file.path("output/global_scatter",
                     paste0("CellScatter_GLOBAL_", cond2, "_vs_", cond1, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(gfile, g, width = 5, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)

  df_pair <- write_pair_diff_csv(
    obj = agg_cond, cond1 = cond1, cond2 = cond2,
    out_dir = "output/global_scatter", topK = 100, min_mean = 0.1,
    rank_by = "abs_lnFC", write_full = TRUE
  )
  df_pair$contrast <- paste0(cond2, "_vs_", cond1)
  df_pair
})

combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_pairs)
combined_df <- combined_df[, c("contrast","rank","gene","x_log","y_log","mean_log",
                               "lnFC","abs_lnFC","log2FC","FC","direction")]
write.csv(combined_df, "output/global_scatter/COMBINED_all_pairs_diffs.csv", row.names = FALSE)

message("Done. Outputs in ./output and ./output/global_scatter")
```

```{r}
# --- Helper: pseudobulk mean (log-normalized) per gene for a state × condition ---
label_col <- if ("transferred_labels_confident" %in% colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))
  "transferred_labels_confident" else "transfered_labels_confident"

# DE should use SCT (not integrated)
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"


pseudobulk_state <- function(seu, state, cond) {
  obj <- subset(seu, subset = transfered_labels_confident == state & condition == cond)
  if (ncol(obj) < 5) stop(paste("Too few cells in", state, cond))
  Matrix::rowMeans(GetAssayData(obj, slot = "data"))
}

# --- Compute effect sizes for one state between two conditions ---
effect_size_table <- function(seu, state, cond1, cond2) {
  m1 <- pseudobulk_state(seu, state, cond1)
  m2 <- pseudobulk_state(seu, state, cond2)
  common <- intersect(names(m1), names(m2))
  m1 <- m1[common]; m2 <- m2[common]
  # effect size: difference on log scale ≈ log2FC
  df <- data.frame(
    gene = common,
    meanA = m1, meanB = m2,
    avg_log2FC = (m2 - m1) / log(2),                 # log2 fold-change
    mean_ab = 0.5 * (m1 + m2),                       # average log-expression
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df[order(-abs(df$avg_log2FC)), ]
}

# --- A) MA plot (effect size only) ---
plot_ma <- function(df, title = "") {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = mean_ab, y = avg_log2FC)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.6) +
    labs(x = "Average log-normalized expression",
         y = "log2 fold change (cond2 vs cond1)",
         title = title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# --- B) Ranked top-|log2FC| bar chart (effect size only) ---
plot_top_fc <- function(df, topN = 15, title = "") {
  top <- head(df, topN)
  ggplot(top, aes(x = reorder(gene, avg_log2FC), y = avg_log2FC, fill = avg_log2FC > 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE"="#1b9e77","FALSE"="#d95f02"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 fold change (cond2 vs cond1)", title = title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# ===== Usage: pick a state & conditions =====
st  <- "MES-like"
c1  <- "BP_Cues"
c2  <- "NS"

es <- effect_size_table(integrated_obj, st, c1, c2)

p_ma  <- plot_ma(es,  paste0(st, "  (", c2, " vs ", c1, ")"))
p_bar <- plot_top_fc(es, topN = 12, title = paste0(st, "  top |log2FC| (", c2, " vs ", c1, ")"))

# Save if you want
ggsave(here::here("output", paste0("MA_", st, "_", c2, "_vs_", c1, ".pdf")),  p_ma,  width = 5, height = 4)
ggsave(here::here("output", paste0("TopFC_", st, "_", c2, "_vs_", c1, ".pdf")), p_bar, width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# ----- Identify the correct label column -----
label_col <- if ("transferred_labels_confident" %in% colnames(integrated_obj@meta.data))
  "transferred_labels_confident" else "transfered_labels_confident"

# ----- Use RNA (not integrated) for DE -----
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
if ("layers" %in% slotNames(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])) {
  integrated_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(integrated_obj[["RNA"]])
}

# Derive states/conditions from the object (avoid hard-coding)
states <- integrated_obj@meta.data[[label_col]] |> as.character() |> unique() |> na.omit() |> sort()
conds  <- integrated_obj@meta.data$condition       |> as.character() |> unique() |> na.omit() |> sort()

message("Using label column: ", label_col)
message("States found: ", paste(states, collapse = ", "))
message("Conditions found: ", paste(conds, collapse = ", "))

outdir <- here("output","de_within_state_all_pairs")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)
summary_rows <- list()

for (st in states) {
  # Robust subsetting by cells
  cells_use <- rownames(integrated_obj@meta.data)[ integrated_obj@meta.data[[label_col]] == st ]
  if (length(cells_use) < 10) {
    message("Skip state '", st, "': only ", length(cells_use), " cells.")
    next
  }

  obj_st <- subset(integrated_obj, cells = cells_use)
  Idents(obj_st) <- "condition"

  pairs <- combn(conds, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (pp in pairs) {
    c1 <- pp[[1]]; c2 <- pp[[2]]
    n1 <- sum(obj_st$condition == c1)
    n2 <- sum(obj_st$condition == c2)

    if (n1 < 10 || n2 < 10) {
      message("Skip ", st, " (", c2, " vs ", c1, "): n=", n2, " vs ", n1, " (<10).")
      next
    }

    # --- DE (Wilcoxon over cells, descriptive) ---
    de_tab <- FindMarkers(
      obj_st, ident.1 = c2, ident.2 = c1,
      test.use = "wilcox", min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.25
    )
    if (nrow(de_tab) == 0) {
      message("No DE genes for ", st, " (", c2, " vs ", c1, ").")
      next
    }

    # --- Add explicit p.adjust on the tested set ---
    de_tab$p_adj_BH_tested    <- p.adjust(de_tab$p_val, method = "BH")
    de_tab$p_adj_bonf_tested  <- p.adjust(de_tab$p_val, method = "bonferroni")

    # --- Recompute detection fractions from RAW COUNTS (strict) ---
    counts <- GetAssayData(obj_st, slot = "counts")
    g1 <- colnames(obj_st)[obj_st$condition == c2]  # ident.1
    g2 <- colnames(obj_st)[obj_st$condition == c1]  # ident.2
    # fractions of cells with >0 counts
    pct1_counts <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts[, g1, drop = FALSE] > 0)
    pct2_counts <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts[, g2, drop = FALSE] > 0)

    # bind as numeric columns (don’t rely only on Seurat’s pct.1/2)
    de_tab$pct1_counts <- pct1_counts[rownames(de_tab)]
    de_tab$pct2_counts <- pct2_counts[rownames(de_tab)]
    de_tab$delta_det_counts <- de_tab$pct1_counts - de_tab$pct2_counts

    # keep Seurat’s pct.1/2 but ensure numeric
    de_tab$pct.1 <- as.numeric(de_tab$pct.1)
    de_tab$pct.2 <- as.numeric(de_tab$pct.2)

    # finalize table
    de_tab$gene <- rownames(de_tab)
    de_tab <- de_tab[order(-abs(de_tab$avg_log2FC)), ]

    # --- Save: raw numeric CSV + pretty TSV for human reading ---
    fname_base <- paste0("DE_", safe_name(st), "_", safe_name(c2), "_vs_", safe_name(c1))

    # raw numeric CSV (machine-friendly)
    write.csv(de_tab,
              file.path(outdir, paste0(fname_base, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)

    # pretty TSV (human-friendly; rounded)
    pretty <- de_tab
    keep_cols <- c("gene","avg_log2FC","p_val","p_val_adj",
                   "p_adj_BH_tested","p_adj_bonf_tested",
                   "pct.1","pct.2","pct1_counts","pct2_counts","delta_det_counts")
    keep_cols <- keep_cols[keep_cols %in% colnames(pretty)]
    pretty <- pretty[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    num_cols <- sapply(pretty, is.numeric)
    pretty[num_cols] <- lapply(pretty[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 6))
    write.table(pretty,
                file = file.path(outdir, paste0(fname_base, "_pretty.tsv")),
                sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

    summary_rows[[length(summary_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      state = st,
      contrast = paste0(c2, " vs ", c1),
      n_cells_c1 = n1,
      n_cells_c2 = n2,
      n_genes_up   = sum(de_tab$avg_log2FC >  0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_genes_down = sum(de_tab$avg_log2FC < -0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    message("Done: ", st, " (", c2, " vs ", c1, ") -> ", fname_base, ".csv / _pretty.tsv")
  }
}

if (length(summary_rows)) {
  summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_rows)
  write.csv(summary_df, file.path(outdir, "SUMMARY_all_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  print(summary_df)
} else {
  message("No contrasts were run. Check state names, condition names, and per-condition cell counts (>=10).")
}
```

## Leading edge genes


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(purrr); library(tidyr)
})

# ---- inputs (your uploaded files) ----
files <- c(
  here("output/gsea_cp/conditions_from_cells/GSEA_cp_BP_Control_vs_NS_Hallmark.csv"),
  here("output/gsea_cp/conditions_from_cells/GSEA_cp_BP_Cues_vs_NS_Hallmark.csv"),
  here("output/gsea_cp/conditions_from_cells/GSEA_cp_BP_Cues_vs_BP_Control_Hallmark.csv")
)

# helper to read a single GSEA cp csv
read_gsea_cp <- function(path){
  df <- suppressWarnings(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))
  df$contrast <- gsub("^GSEA_cp_|_Hallmark\\.csv$", "", basename(path))
  df
}

gsea_all <- files %>% map_df(read_gsea_cp)

# Keep only Hallmarks of interest
targets <- c("HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION", "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION")
gsea_sel <- gsea_all %>%
  filter(ID %in% targets) %>%
  # ensure required columns exist and are numeric
  mutate(NES = as.numeric(NES),
         p.adjust = as.numeric(p.adjust))

# Extract leading-edge gene list per (ID, contrast)
# clusterProfiler stores leading edge in 'core_enrichment' separated by '/'
lead_tbl <- gsea_sel %>%
  transmute(
    ID, contrast, NES, p.adjust,
    weight = abs(NES) * (-log10(p.adjust + 1e-300)),  # robustness to zeros
    genes = str_split(core_enrichment, "/")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(genes) %>%
  mutate(genes = toupper(trimws(genes)))

# Rank genes within each pathway by cumulative weight across contrasts
lead_rank <- lead_tbl %>%
  group_by(ID, genes) %>%
  summarise(
    n_contrasts = n_distinct(contrast),
    cum_weight  = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_FDR    = min(p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID, desc(cum_weight), best_FDR)

# Pick a tidy panel size (edit if you prefer)
top_emt   <- lead_rank %>% filter(ID == "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION") %>% slice_head(n = 10)
top_apj   <- lead_rank %>% filter(ID == "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION") %>% slice_head(n = 8)

panel_genes_upper <- c(top_emt$genes, top_apj$genes) %>% unique()

```

```{r}
# Map uppercase → object feature names (handles case mismatches)
obj_genes_upper <- toupper(rownames(integrated_obj))
map_back <- setNames(rownames(integrated_obj), obj_genes_upper)

panel_genes <- unname(map_back[intersect(panel_genes_upper, names(map_back))])
panel_genes <- panel_genes[!is.na(panel_genes)]

# Keep EMT first then Apical order for plot
emt_genes   <- unname(map_back[intersect(top_emt$genes, names(map_back))])
apj_genes   <- unname(map_back[intersect(top_apj$genes, names(map_back))])
features_ordered <- c(emt_genes, apj_genes)

# Save the final gene panel (for SI)
readr::write_csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    pathway = c(rep("EMT", length(emt_genes)), rep("Apical_Junction", length(apj_genes))),
    gene = features_ordered
  ),
  "leading_edge_gene_panel.csv"
)

```


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize); library(grid)
  library(dplyr); library(tibble); library(here)
})

# =========================
# 1) Your leading-edge gene vectors
# =========================
le_control_vs_ns <- c("CCN1","ID2","NTM","SPP1","JUN","RHOB","SLIT2","IGFBP2",
                      "BASP1","TNC","CD59","DST","HTRA1","GJA1","GPC1","MATN2",
                      "PRRX1","PFN2")

le_cues_vs_ns <- c("CCN1","ID2","JUN","SLIT2","IGFBP2","RHOB","GJA1","NTM",
                   "TNC","GPC1","HTRA1","TIMP3","LRP1","CD59","DST","SPARC",
                   "BASP1","CAP2","PFN2","ITGAV","SPP1","MATN2","CDH2","IGFBP4",
                   "GADD45A","COL11A1","PRRX1","COLGALT1","FSTL1","CALD1","PLOD2",
                   "SPOCK1","FBN2")

le_cues_vs_control <- c("COLGALT1","COL4A2","EMP3","TPM1","MMP14","LAMC1","LGALS1",
                        "IGFBP4","NOTCH2","VIM","SPARC","TNFRSF12A","COL4A1","GJA1",
                        "FLNA","PLOD1","SPOCK1","TIMP1","SGCB","THY1","GAS1","FERMT2",
                        "LRP1","ENO2","JUN","PLOD3","ELN","ITGAV","PLAUR","GPC1","TIMP3",
                        "TNFAIP3","IGFBP2","SLIT2","PMP22","IGFBP3")

# =========================
# 2) Build presence matrix (genes x contrasts)
# =========================
all_genes <- sort(unique(c(le_control_vs_ns, le_cues_vs_ns, le_cues_vs_control)))
mat <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = 3,
              dimnames = list(all_genes,
                              c("Bioinert vs\nScaffold-free",
                                "Biofunctional vs\nScaffold-free",
                                "Biofunctional vs\nBioinert")))
mat[rownames(mat) %in% le_control_vs_ns,   1] <- 1L
mat[rownames(mat) %in% le_cues_vs_ns,      2] <- 1L
mat[rownames(mat) %in% le_cues_vs_control, 3] <- 1L

# =========================
# 3) Compute category (Core / Embedding / Cue)
# =========================
bn <- mat[,1] == 1
cn <- mat[,2] == 1
cb <- mat[,3] == 1

row_category <- ifelse(bn & cn & cb, "Core",
                  ifelse((bn | cn) & !cb, "Embedding-shared", "Cue-specific"))

row_split <- factor(row_category, levels=c("Core","Embedding-shared","Cue-specific"))

# order rows
ord <- order(row_split, -rowSums(mat), rownames(mat))
mat <- mat[ord, , drop=FALSE]
row_split <- droplevels(row_split[ord])

# =========================
# 4) Aesthetic settings (your preferences)
# =========================

# Deep blue palette (the nicer one)
bin_col <- c("0"="#ECEFF1", "1"="#1F4E79")   # light grey → deep blue

# Category colours
cat_col <- c(Core="#2E7D32", "Embedding-shared"="#FB8C00", "Cue-specific"="#C62828")

left_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Category=row_split,
  col=list(Category=cat_col),
  annotation_legend_param=list(title="Category", nrow=3)
)

# =========================
# MAIN HEATMAP WITH THICKER BORDERS
# =========================
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name="Leading-edge",
  col=bin_col,
  cluster_rows=FALSE,
  cluster_columns=FALSE,
  row_split=row_split,
  row_gap=unit(4,"mm"),                     # larger gap to separate categories
  show_row_names=TRUE,
  row_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=8),
  show_column_names=TRUE,
  column_names_rot=0,
  column_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=10,fontface="bold"),
  left_annotation=left_anno,
  
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.7, fill = NA))
}

  
  # thicker borders between cells
  border=FALSE,
  border_gp=gpar(col="black", lwd=0.1),       # thicker cell grid lines
  
  # nicer legend
  heatmap_legend_param=list(
    at=c(0,1),
    labels=c("Not present","Present"),
    legend_direction="horizontal",
    nrow=1,
    title=NULL
  ),
  
  na_col="#D9D9D9"
)

# =========================
# 5) Add thicker borders around category blocks
# =========================
ht <- draw(ht, padding=unit(c(6,6,6,6),"mm"))

# decorate each row-split region with a subtle outer border
decorate_heatmap_body("Leading-edge", {
  # Get height/width
  nr <- nrow(mat)
  nc <- ncol(mat)
  
  # draw category block outlines
  split_vec <- row_split
  idx <- which(diff(as.integer(split_vec))!=0)   # boundaries
  block_positions <- c(0, idx, nr)
  
  for (i in seq_along(block_positions)[-1]) {
    top <- (block_positions[i-1])/nr
    bottom <- (block_positions[i])/nr
    grid.rect(
      x=0.5, y=top + (bottom-top)/2,
      width=1, height=(bottom-top),
      gp=gpar(fill=NA, col="#444444", lwd=1.5)    # thicker border for category block
    )
  }
})

# =========================
# 6) Save output
# =========================
out_dir <- here::here("output"); if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir,TRUE)

# auto height
n <- nrow(mat)
pdf_h <- max(6, min(18, 6 + 0.16*(n/10)))
png_h <- max(1500, min(6000, round(900 + 18*n)))

pdf(file.path(out_dir,"LeadingEdge_genes_heatmap_nice.pdf"),
    width=7.2, height=pdf_h, useDingbats=FALSE)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

png(file.path(out_dir,"LeadingEdge_genes_heatmap_nice.png"),
    width=2300, height=png_h, res=300)
draw(ht)
dev.off()


```
